_about: Sir Samuel Morland (1625-1695), Cromwell's envoy to Savoy after the massacre of 1655: The History of the Evangelical Churches of the Valleys of Piemont, with a relation of the bloody massacre of 1655 and the transactions to 1658 (London, 1658). A 17th-century printing in long-s type; much of it prints Waldensian documents in their original languages beside English. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
